verdict.rationale: Adyen's own Management API is documented under 'automating terminal management' and lets developers order terminals and accessories through API requests rather than the Customer Area, so some fleet operations are API-driven. The evidence shows ongoing terminal management only through the Customer Area UI or in marketing copy. missing for 10: API-based device registration/assignment, remote terminal status monitoring, remote configuration updates via API, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage a fleet of readers and terminals via API — register devices, monitor status, and update configuration remotely

citations.quote: The Management API lets you order terminals and accessories for delivery to a location of your choice using API requests instead of the Customer Area.
Simplify everything from terminal management to financial reconciliation.
